# Customer Support Ticket System - Main Application Entrypoint
from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
from typing import List
import os

from backend.routes import tickets, departments, auth

app = FastAPI(
    title="Customer Support Ticket System API",
    description="Production API generated by AI Product Architect for: Build a customer support ticket system with ticket creation, assignment, priorit...",
    version="1.0.0"
)

app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=["*"],
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)

app.include_router(tickets.router, prefix="/api/tickets", tags=["Ticket Management"])
app.include_router(departments.router, prefix="/api/departments", tags=["Department Management"])
app.include_router(auth.router, prefix="/api/auth", tags=["Authentication"])

@app.get("/health")
def health_check():
    return {"status": "healthy", "service": "Customer Support Ticket System", "version": "1.0.0"}

@app.get("/")
def root():
    return {"message": "Welcome to Customer Support Ticket System API", "docs_url": "/docs"}

# SQLAlchemy Models for Customer Support Ticket System
from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Text, Float, Boolean, DateTime, ForeignKey
from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base, relationship
from datetime import datetime

Base = declarative_base()

class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = "users"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    email = Column(String(255), nullable=False, unique=True, index=True)
    hashed_password = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    role = Column(String(50), nullable=False)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class Department(Base):
    __tablename__ = "departments"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    name = Column(String(100), nullable=False)
    sla_hours = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)

class Ticket(Base):
    __tablename__ = "tickets"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    customer_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    assigned_agent_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    department = Column(String(100), nullable=False, index=True)
    subject = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    description = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    priority = Column(String(50), nullable=False, index=True)
    status = Column(String(50), nullable=False, index=True)
    sla_deadline = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)
    updated_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class TicketComment(Base):
    __tablename__ = "ticket_comments"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    ticket_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    user_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    content = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    is_internal = Column(Boolean, default=True)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

# Automated Integration Tests for Customer Support Ticket System
import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from backend.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_health():
    res = client.get("/health")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert res.json()["status"] == "healthy"

def test_root():
    res = client.get("/")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert "Welcome" in res.json()["message"]

def test_auth_flow():
    res = client.post("/api/auth/login", json={"email": "test@enterprise.io", "password": "SecretPassword123"})
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert "access_token" in res.json()

def test_list_tickets():
    res = client.get("/api/tickets/")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert isinstance(res.json(), list)

def test_create_ticket():
    payload = {"title": "Automated Test Ticket", "name": "Automated Test Ticket", "description": "Verification Record", "priority": "high"}
    res = client.post("/api/tickets/", json=payload)
    assert res.status_code == 201
    data = res.json()
    assert data.get("title") == "Automated Test Ticket" or data.get("name") == "Automated Test Ticket"

def test_assign_ticket():
    res = client.patch("/api/tickets/1/assign?agent_id=3")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert res.json()["assigned_agent_id"] == 3

files.README.md:
# Customer Support Ticket System

Production cloud microservice generated by **AI Product Architect**.

## Domain Overview
- **Domain Category**: Customer Support & SLA Ticket System
- **Description**: Enterprise customer support desk with ticket queues, agent assignment, comment threads, and SLA tracking.
- **Primary Entity**: `Ticket`
- **Entities**: `User`, `Department`, `Ticket`, `TicketComment`

## Architecture Specification
- **Compute**: AWS ECS Fargate
- **Database**: PostgreSQL 15 RDS
- **Cache**: None
- **Security**: JWT OAuth2 Bearer Tokens, Bcrypt Password Hashing, CORS Guards

## Architecture Topology
```mermaid
flowchart TD
  subgraph Ticket Channels
    USER["Customer Help Center"]
    AGENT["Support Agent Workspace"]
  end

  subgraph Ingress & Identity
    ALB["Cloud Load Balancer"]
    AUTH["RBAC (Customer / Agent / Admin)"]
  end

  subgraph Microservice Core
    API["Customer Support Ticket System Ticket Core API"]
    SLA["SLA Breached Deadline Monitor"]
    NOTIF["Email / Webhook Notification Worker"]
  end

  subgraph Relational Database
    PG[("PostgreSQL (Tickets, Comments, Departments)")]
  end

  USER --> ALB --> AUTH --> API
  AGENT --> ALB --> AUTH --> API
  API --> SLA
  API --> NOTIF
  SLA --> PG
  API --> PG
```

## Quick Start
```bash
# 1. Run local multi-container environment
docker-compose up --build

# 2. Check Service Health
curl http://localhost:8000/health
```

## API Documentation
- Interactive Swagger UI: `http://localhost:8000/docs`
- Live Deployment Preview: `http://localhost:8000/preview/customer-support-ticket-system`
